<style>
/* Layout: wordmark hero with the dine-in / delivery switch beside it, then Tiffin, Lunch and Dinner dish grids (left) and a sticky order panel (right); on phones the panel is a full-screen sheet opened from a bottom bar. */
:root {
  --bg: #F5F7F2;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --soft: #EBF0E6;
  --ink: #16261D;
  --muted: #5B6A60;
  --line: #D9E0D5;
  --accent: #B42318;
  --accent-ink: #FFFFFF;
  --leaf: #1E7B45;
  --leaf-ink: #FFFFFF;
  --display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Arial Narrow", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --body: "Figtree", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg: #0F1712; --surface: #17211B; --soft: #1E2A23; --ink: #EEF3EC; --muted: #9DABA2;
    --line: #2B3830; --accent: #F0705B; --accent-ink: #1C0A06; --leaf: #52C47F; --leaf-ink: #0B1A10;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #0F1712; --surface: #17211B; --soft: #1E2A23; --ink: #EEF3EC; --muted: #9DABA2;
  --line: #2B3830; --accent: #F0705B; --accent-ink: #1C0A06; --leaf: #52C47F; --leaf-ink: #0B1A10;
  color-scheme: dark;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--body); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5;
  padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
  padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  padding-block: 0 96px;
}
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
h1, h2, h3, h4 { margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
p { margin: 0; }
.wrap { max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto; }

/* hero */
.hero { display: grid; gap: 24px; padding-block: 28px 20px; align-items: end; }
.brand { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(3rem, 14vw, 5.6rem); line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
.brand span { color: var(--accent); display: block; }
.lede { margin-top: 14px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 36ch; font-size: 1rem; }
.modes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; background: var(--soft); padding: 6px; border-radius: 16px; }
.mode { border: 0; background: transparent; text-align: left; padding: 14px; border-radius: 11px; display: grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.mode b { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.mode small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; }
.mode[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent) inset; }
.mode[aria-pressed="true"] b { color: var(--accent); }

/* tabs */
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-block: 8px 6px; scrollbar-width: none; }
.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.tab { flex: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 16px; font-weight: 500; }
.tab[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-color: var(--ink); }

/* layout */
.layout { display: grid; gap: 24px; align-items: start; }
.menu { min-width: 0; }
.sh { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; padding-block: 22px 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.sh h3 { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.sh .time { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.sh .now { background: var(--leaf); color: var(--leaf-ink); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.grid { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 20px 14px; }
.card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.art svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 14px; }
.cb { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.cb h4 { font-size: .98rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; }
.meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 10px; align-items: baseline; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.price { font-weight: 600; }
.ctl { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 8px; }
.add { width: 100%; border: 1.5px solid var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 7px 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.add:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.step { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border-radius: 10px; }
.ctl .step { width: 100%; }
.step button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; width: 36px; height: 34px; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 10px; }
.step button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.step output { min-width: 22px; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* order panel */
.cart { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 20; background: var(--surface); overflow-y: auto; transform: translateY(100%); visibility: hidden; transition: transform .25s ease, visibility 0s .25s;
  padding-top: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); padding-bottom: calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); }
.cart.open { transform: none; visibility: visible; transition: transform .25s ease; }
.cart-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cart-head h2 { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.close { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 14px; }
.modeline { color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; margin-top: 4px; }
.empty { margin-top: 18px; padding: 22px 16px; border: 1.5px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }
.line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 6px 12px; padding-block: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); align-items: center; }
.line .t { font-weight: 600; min-width: 0; }
.line .t small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; font-size: .8rem; }
.line .lp { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }
.line .step { justify-self: start; min-width: 104px; }
.totals { margin: 14px 0 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.totals div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.totals .grand { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.15rem; }
.totals dt, .totals dd { margin: 0; }
form { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin-top: 20px; }
.field { display: grid; gap: 5px; }
    }).then(function (r) {
      return r.json().then(function (j) { return r.ok && (j.success === true || j.success === "true"); });
    }).catch(function () { return false; }).then(function (ok) { clearTimeout(timer); return ok; });
  } catch (e) { clearTimeout(timer); return Promise.resolve(false); }
}

function row(label, value, cls) {
  var d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "rr" + (cls ? " " + cls : "");
  var a = document.createElement("span"); a.textContent = label;
  var b = document.createElement("span"); b.textContent = value;
  d.appendChild(a); d.appendChild(b);
  return d;
}
function renderReceipt(no, name, phone, where, t, notes) {
  var box = $("summary"); box.textContent = "";
  box.appendChild(row("Order number", no, "no"));
  box.appendChild(row("Name", name));
  box.appendChild(row("Phone", phone));
  box.appendChild(row("Order type", where));
  box.appendChild(row("Payment", state.payLabel));
  var list = document.createElement("div"); list.className = "rl";
  Object.keys(state.cart).forEach(function (id) {
    var m = byId[id], q = state.cart[id];
    list.appendChild(row(q + " \u00D7 " + m.name + " (" + svcById[m.svc].name + ")", rupee(m.price * q)));
  });
  if (GST_RATE > 0) list.appendChild(row("GST", rupee(t.gst)));
  if (t.fee > 0) list.appendChild(row("Tiffin box", rupee(t.fee)));
  box.appendChild(list);
  box.appendChild(row("Total", rupee(t.total), "tot"));
  if (notes) box.appendChild(row("Notes", notes));
}
function setTick(kind) {
        : "We could not send it by email. Send it on WhatsApp instead, or try again.";
      $("retryBtn").hidden = ok;
    });
  };
  $("modal").hidden = false;
  $("doneTitle").setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
  $("doneTitle").focus();
  state.send();
});

$("retryBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { if (state.send) state.send(); });

function closeModal() {
  $("modal").hidden = true;
  if (!state.sent) return;
  state.cart = {}; state.text = "";
  ["f-name", "f-phone", "f-notes"].forEach(function (id) { $(id).value = ""; });
  document.querySelector('input[name="pay"][value="cod"]').checked = true;
  updatePay();
  closeCart();
  renderControls();
}
$("doneClose").addEventListener("click", closeModal);
document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape" && !$("modal").hidden) closeModal(); });

renderTabs();
setMode("takeaway");
renderControls();
</script>
